title: Yellow Caramelized Turkish Parsley Dolma
description: A savory and cozy Turkish dish featuring caramelized parsley and molten flavors, perfect for a vegetarian-friendly meal.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the sliced onions and cook until they are caramelized and golden brown.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the chopped parsley and cook until it is wilted.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked rice, parsley mixture, salt, and black pepper.
Mix well and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Stuff the rice mixture into bell peppers or zucchini boats.
Place the stuffed vegetables in a baking dish and drizzle with lemon juice.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake at 375 degrees Fahrenheit for 25 minutes.
